rows.expectation: Do not add room editing/deletion, recurring bookings, reminders, new statuses or automatic cancellation as confirmed requirements.
Do not make PO, BA, Developer or QA product users solely because they are on the team; do not equate Administrator with PO.
Do not declare the conflict resolved by PO authority; do not treat deployment as launch permission.
